title: OakNorth finances two UK assets for Jamestown-advised fund
summary:
OakNorth has provided property finance to a European investor advised by Jamestown for two UK commercial assets, covering an acquisition in Surrey and a refinancing in Edinburgh. The facility supports the acquisition of Lion & Lamb Yard in Farnham and the refinancing of existing debt on Lochrin Square in Edinburgh.

title: Aberdeen office secures £8.4m bridging loan in one month
summary:
Pallas Capital has provided an £8.4m bridging finance facility on a Grade A office building and car park in Aberdeen, completing the 12-month loan within a one-month timeframe. The 60,000 sq ft property was refinanced at 70% loan-to-value while the borrower arranged longer-term commercial debt.

title: TV presenter purchases Surrey home from Omaze prize winner
summary:
Television presenter Alan Titchmarsh has acquired a six-bedroom property in Surrey for £2.75 million from an Omaze prize draw winner. The property, which sits on 1.4 acres and includes sustainable features, was sold in October 2025.

title: Bank of England MPC member signals support for rate rise
summary:
A Bank of England policymaker has indicated support for raising interest rates, increasing the likelihood of higher borrowing costs ahead of the Monetary Policy Committee's next decision on 18th June. Megan Greene stated that a tightening in monetary policy may be necessary in the coming weeks or months.

title: Survey reveals tenant concerns over landlord compliance
summary:
A survey of over 1,100 tenants has found widespread uncertainty about whether landlords and managing agents have fully complied with the Renters' Rights Act. Only 32% of tenants believe their landlord or property manager is fully compliant with the new legislation.

The post Survey reveals tenant concerns over landlord compliance appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Conveyancing regulator finds transparency gaps in referrals
summary:
The Council for Licensed Conveyancers has found that almost half of 12 examined solicitor practices could not produce written agreements covering referral fees from estate agents. The regulatory body has issued 19 recommendations to improve transparency in conveyancing referral arrangements.

The post Conveyancing regulator finds transparency gaps in referrals appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Off-plan buyers gain £26,000 before completion, data shows
summary:
Buyers purchasing new-build properties off-plan in London have seen average gains of £26,000 before completion, according to analysis by Foxtons. The estate agency's data shows that new-build house prices across the capital have increased by an average of 0.23% per month over the past five years.

title: Land Registry launches trial to tackle property sale failures
summary:
HM Land Registry has approved a 12-month trial scheme designed to reduce property sale fall-throughs by enabling sellers to identify and correct data errors before marketing their homes. The proof of concept, operated by the Residential Logbook Association, will allow homeowners to access their Land Registry title data through digital property logbooks prior to listing properties for sale.

title: London rental growth stable despite new legislation
summary:
London landlords have maintained consistent rental growth rates following the introduction of the Renters' Rights Act, with rents increasing by just 0.7% in the five months after Royal Assent. The figures challenge concerns that new regulations would trigger significant rent increases across the capital.
